about: Raglan long-sleeve tee (raglan-longsleeve-textured.glb, RUGBYV 2026-11-20): coloured from the same garment split into parts by Tripo (raglan-longsleeve-parts.glb): body and hem band the print; each raglan sleeve from the neck band to the cuff, cuff included, its Left (+x) / Right (-x) sleeve part (Tripo gives both sleeves as one part, split at the middle); the round neck band the Collar colour, one even width from the neck's fold; linings as the cloth behind them. (Even-width collar off: with it the sleeve tops stopped short of the neck band in a ragged print strip; speck 40 / island 150 take in collar flecks.)
